department: Neuroscience Program (College of Science and Engineering)

deadline.value: January 5, 2027 priority deadline for admission and Graduate Assistantship consideration (rolling review thereafter only at a prospective faculty mentor's request).
deadline.quote: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis; however, strong preference is given to complete applications received on or before January 5.

also.quote: Graduate assistantships: Jan. 5 for priority consideration

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional for the Neuroscience Ph.D.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test or entrance exam is required (Bulletin snapshot lists Entrance Exam: None and GRE scores are optional).
gre_subject.quote: Entrance Exam: None | GRE scores are optional.

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact Neuroscience faculty prior to applying and select faculty of interest in the online application.
supervisor.quote: Students are encouraged to contact Program faculty members in their area of research interest prior to submitting application materials.

also.quote: Select the NSC faculty you are interested in working with within the online application.

funding.value: Graduate research assistantships provide a stipend and tuition remission based on yearly progress alongside university Graduate Assistantships.
funding.quote: Graduate research assistantships: Based on yearly progress, these assistantships provide a stipend and tuition remission.

also.quote: Graduate assistant positions provide a stipend as well as a tuition waiver.

entry_route.value: Bachelor of Science degree (or equivalent) with at least 5 upper-level biology/chemistry/neuroscience courses and one statistics course (minimum 61 graduate semester hours).
entry_route.quote: Applicants are expected to obtain a Bachelor of Science degree (or equivalent) before starting in the program.

notes: 61-credit-hour multidisciplinary Ph.D. in Neuroscience spanning cellular/molecular to behavioral neuroscience across Biology, Chemistry, Health Sciences, Psychology, and Medicine.
name: Ph.D. in Neuroscience
